title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (I)

articles.content_en: Article 1 After the implementation of the Company Law, for civil cases that the People's Court has not yet concluded and newly accepted, where the civil conduct or events occurred before the implementation of the Company Law, the laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations in force at that time shall apply.

Article 2 Where a dispute arising from civil conduct or events before the implementation of the Company Law is prosecuted to the People's Court, if the laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations at that time have no clear provisions, the relevant provisions of the Company Law may be applied by reference.

Article 3 Where a plaintiff brings an action in the People's Court on the grounds specified in Article 22, paragraph 2, and Article 74, paragraph 2 of the Company Law, if the time limit prescribed by the Company Law is exceeded, the People's Court shall not accept the case.

Article 4 The period of continuous shareholding of 180 days or more provided for in Article 151 of the Company Law shall be the shareholding period that has expired at the time the shareholder brings an action in the People's Court; the aggregate holding of one percent or more of the company's shares as provided for refers to the total of the shareholdings of two or more shareholders.

Article 5 When the People's Court conducts a retrial according to law of a case that has already been finally adjudicated before the implementation of the Company Law, the provisions of the Company Law shall not apply.
Article 6 These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
